segments.ja405:1.1: Dvāsattati gotama [bho gotama (ka.)] puññakammā, vasavattino jātijaraṃ atītā;
segments.ja405:1.3: Ayamantimā vedagū brahmapatti [brahmupapatti (syā. ka.)], asmābhijappanti janā [pajā (ka.)] anekā.
segments.ja405:2.1: Appañhi etaṃ [appañca hetaṃ (syā.), appaṃsi etaṃ (ka.)] na hi dīghamāyu, yaṃ tvaṃ baka maññasi dīghamāyuṃ;
segments.ja405:2.3: Sataṃ sahassāni [sahassānaṃ (sī. pī. saṃ. ni.1.175), sahassāna (syā. kaṃ.)] nirabbudānaṃ, āyuṃ pajānāmi tavāha brahme.
segments.ja405:3.3: Kiṃ me purāṇaṃ vatasīlavattaṃ [sīlavantaṃ (pī. ka.)], ācikkha me taṃ yamahaṃ vijaññaṃ.
segments.ja405:4.1: Yaṃ tvaṃ apāyesi bahū manusse, pipāsite ghammani samparete;
segments.ja405:4.3: Taṃ te purāṇaṃ vatasīlavattaṃ, suttappabuddhova anussarāmi.
segments.ja405:5.1: Yaṃ eṇikūlasmi janaṃ gahītaṃ, amocayī gayhaka niyyamānaṃ;
segments.ja405:5.3: Taṃ te purāṇaṃ vatasīlavattaṃ, suttappabuddhova anussarāmi.
segments.ja405:6.1: Gaṅgāya sotasmiṃ gahītanāvaṃ, luddena nāgena manussakappā;
segments.ja405:6.3: Amocayi tvaṃ balasā pasayha, taṃ te purāṇaṃ vatasīlavattaṃ;
segments.ja405:7.1: Kappo ca te baddhacaro [patthacaro (syā.), paṭṭhacaro (ka.)] ahosi, sambuddhimantaṃ [sambuddhivantaṃ (syā. pī.), sambuddhavantaṃ (ka.)] vatinaṃ [vatitaṃ (syā.), vatidaṃ (ka.)] amaññaṃ;
segments.ja405:7.3: Taṃ te purāṇaṃ vatasīlavattaṃ, suttappabuddhova anussarāmi.
segments.ja405:8.1: Addhā pajānāsi mametamāyuṃ, aññampi jānāsi tathā hi buddho;
segments.ja405:8.3: Tathā hi tāyaṃ [tyāyaṃ (saṃ. ni.1.175)] jalitānubhāvo, obhāsayaṃ tiṭṭhati brahmalokanti.
segments.ja405:11.1: Varakaṇṇika cāpavaro sutano, atha gijjha sarohitamacchavaro;
segments.ja405:11.3: Puna paṇṇaka [dasaṇṇaka (sī. syā. pī.)] senaka yācanako, atha veri sabrahmabakena dasāti.
